description: Same APOE targeted-replacement mice as the EC analysis (male, 14-15 months, APOE3/4 n=19 vs APOE3/3 n=10); bulk RNA-seq of primary visual cortex, FDR <0.05 threshold. Caveat: mouse, aged, bulk tissue; transcript level only.

provenance.excerpt: Importantly, none of these genes were shown to be differentially expressed in the PVC, suggesting that APOE4-mediated endosomal-lysosomal pathology may be occurring predominantly in AD-vulnerable brain regions such as the EC.

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE3/4) -> (no change in V-ATPase mRNA in primary visual cortex) [NO EFFECT]
meccogFinding.dataLocation: Results text, p. 6; Supplementary Table S2

measured.variable: mRNA expression of V-ATPase subunits and other endosomal-lysosomal genes in primary visual cortex
